adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for updateEvent: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` - When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the fallback tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (which is undefined), so it will never find a match and return undefined. The same bug exists in deleteEvent at line 314-316. This is a real logic error where the fallback condition is broken - it should likely be finding based on credentialId or some other criteria, not comparing against the undefined externalCalendarId.
